crossRefs.note: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

translations.web: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.
translations.bsb: A quiver rattles at his side, along with a flashing spear and lance.
translations.kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
translations.asv: The quiver rattleth against him, The flashing spear and the javelin.
